Do you have any suggestions on how to do this?

Many thanks,
Rujiporn

Bestus

Hi Shandiya,

You need to ask Diversity Arrays Technology to provide the trimmed sequences when you request your report.

Without them, you should have got an error message.

messages.subject: New version of dartR on github
messages.subject_clean: New version of dartR on github
messages.body_plain:
Hi guys,

A new version of dartR is on the github (but not yet on CRAN). Version 1.22 has the following changes implemented:
Added an option for reporting and filtering on heterozygosity by individual in gl.report.heterozygosity() and gl.filter.heterozygosity() respectively. By request.
Added a script to import data from a csv file to dartR for those not using Diversity Arrays Technology for their genotyping. Called gl.read.csv(). Allows association with locus and individual metrics, and calculates DArT locus metrics from the input data where possible. By request.
Added a script to swap in an individual metric to the pop. Called gl.reassign.pop(). By request.
Added read depth to the locus metrics, calculated on input of the data from the DArT locus metrics. This backcalculates the read depth from the locus metrics provided by DArT rather than relying on the count dataset that can optionally be obtained from DArT.
Set mono.rm=FALSE as the default in all scripts so that the user needs to explicitly remove monomorphs with gl.filter.monomorphs(). By request.
Added a script to prepare an object from the specified gl object, for use by R package stockR (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/stockR/)
Added an option to functions gl.drop.pop() and gl.keep.pop() to filter on an individual metric other than pop. See the as.pop parameter in these scripts. By request.
Added a heat map option to gl.fixed.diff
Revised gl.collapse to be stand alone (to be used repeatedly) and to plot the results of the collapsing of populations as a pcoa plot.
Revised gl.collapse.pval to be stand alone (to be used after gl.collapse) and to plot the results of further collapsing the populations on the basis of significance, including a pcoa plot.
Added an estimate of unscored invariant loci to gl.report.secondaries, using estimates from a truncated Poisson distribution to estimate the zero class of the associated untruncated distribution.
Added option to specify number of invariant loci to gl.report.heterozygosity.
Fixed a bug in gl2snapp which occurred if the samples were not sorted on population.
Altered the algorithm in gl.sexlinkage, renamed to gl.report.snpsexlinkage
Minor bug fixes.
Let us know if there are any issues with this developmental version.
